description: Did the person's coins beat Bitcoin: their holdings as they would paste them on StockMap's Bitcoin test page ("ETH 2, SOL 40 since Jan 15"), priced then and now beside the same dollars held in Bitcoin, from CoinGecko's prices. Nothing is stored. Arithmetic on past prices: no call on any coin, and no advice on the holdings. Each answer carries the stamp, the sources and the not-advice line.
